verses.original: וּמֹשֶׁ֗ה הָיָ֥ה רֹעֶ֛ה אֶת־ צֹ֛אן יִתְר֥וֹ חֹתְנ֖וֹ כֹּהֵ֣ן מִדְיָ֑ן וַיִּנְהַ֤ג אֶת־ הַצֹּאן֙ אַחַ֣ר הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר וַיָּבֹ֛א אֶל־ הַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים חֹרֵֽבָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·šeh hā·yāh rō·‘eh ’eṯ- ṣōn yiṯ·rōw ḥō·ṯə·nōw kō·hên miḏ·yān way·yin·haḡ ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣōn ’a·ḥar ham·miḏ·bār way·yā·ḇō ’el- har hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥō·rê·ḇāh
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Moses was shepherding the flock of his father-in-law Jethro the priest of Midian He led the flock to the far side of the wilderness and came to Horeb the mountain of God
verses.literalPt: Ora, Moisés, apascentando o rebanho de Jetro, seu sogro, sacerdote de Midiã, levou-o para trás do deserto e veio a Horebe, monte de Deus.

verses.original: וַ֠יֵּרָא מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֵלָ֛יו בְּלַבַּת־ אֵ֖שׁ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַסְּנֶ֑ה וַיַּ֗רְא וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַסְּנֶה֙ בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְהַסְּנֶ֖ה אֵינֶ֥נּוּ אֻכָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ’ê·lāw bə·lab·baṯ- ’êš mit·tō·wḵ has·sə·neh way·yar wə·hin·nêh has·sə·neh bō·‘êr bā·’êš wə·has·sə·neh ’ê·nen·nū ’uk·kāl
verses.literal: There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in a blazing fire from within a bush Moses saw . . . the bush ablaze with fire . . . but it was not consumed
verses.literalPt: Apareceu-lhe o Anjo de Jeová numa chama de fogo do meio duma sarça; Moisés olhou, e eis que a sarça ardia no fogo e a sarça não se consumia.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אָסֻֽרָה־ נָּ֣א וְאֶרְאֶ֔ה אֶת־ הַמַּרְאֶ֥ה הַגָּדֹ֖ל הַזֶּ֑ה מַדּ֖וּעַ לֹא־ יִבְעַ֥ר הַסְּנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’ā·su·rāh- nā wə·’er·’eh ’eṯ- ham·mar·’eh hag·gā·ḏōl haz·zeh mad·dū·a‘ lō- yiḇ·‘ar has·sə·neh
verses.literal: So Moses thought I must go over . . . and see this marvelous sight Why is the bush not burning up
verses.literalPt: Disse, pois: Voltar-me-ei e verei esta grande visão, porque não se queima a sarça.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֣י סָ֣ר לִרְא֑וֹת וַיִּקְרָא֩ אֵלָ֨יו אֱלֹהִ֜ים מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַסְּנֶ֗ה וַיֹּ֛אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֥ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הִנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar Yah·weh kî sār lir·’ō·wṯ way·yiq·rā ’ê·lāw ’ĕ·lō·hîm mit·tō·wḵ has·sə·neh way·yō·mer mō·šeh mō·šeh way·yō·mer hin·nê·nî
verses.literal: When the LORD saw that he had gone over to look God called out to him from within the bush Moses Moses Here I am he answered
verses.literalPt: Vendo Jeová que ele se voltou para ver, do meio da sarça chamou-o Deus e disse: Moisés, Moisés! Respondeu ele: Eis-me aqui!

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אַל־ תִּקְרַ֣ב הֲלֹ֑ם שַׁל־ נְעָלֶ֙יךָ֙ מֵעַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֔יךָ כִּ֣י הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ עוֹמֵ֣ד עָלָ֔יו אַדְמַת־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’al- tiq·raḇ hă·lōm šal- nə·‘ā·le·ḵā mê·‘al raḡ·le·ḵā kî ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer ’at·tāh ‘ō·w·mêḏ ‘ā·lāw ’aḏ·maṯ- qō·ḏeš hū
verses.literal: Do not come any closer God said Take off your sandals . . . . . . for the place where you are standing . . . is holy . . . ground
verses.literalPt: Deus continuou: Não te chegues para cá; tira as sandálias dos pés, porque o lugar em que tu estás é terra santa.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אָנֹכִי֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אָבִ֔יךָ אֱלֹהֵ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִצְחָ֖ק וֵאלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב וַיַּסְתֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ פָּנָ֔יו כִּ֣י יָרֵ֔א מֵהַבִּ֖יט אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ā·ḇî·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ĕ·lō·hê yiṣ·ḥāq wê·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yas·têr mō·šeh pā·nāw kî yā·rê mê·hab·bîṭ ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Then He said I am the God of your father the God of Abraham the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob At this, Moses hid his face for he was afraid to look at God
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe mais: Eu sou o Deus de teu pai, o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque e o Deus de Jacó. Moisés escondeu o rosto, pois teve medo de olhar para Deus.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה רָאֹ֥ה רָאִ֛יתִי אֶת־ עֳנִ֥י עַמִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־ צַעֲקָתָ֤ם שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י נֹֽגְשָׂ֔יו כִּ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי אֶת־ מַכְאֹבָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh rā·’ōh rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- ‘o·nî ‘am·mî ’ă·šer bə·miṣ·rā·yim wə·’eṯ- ṣa·‘ă·qā·ṯām šā·ma‘·tî mip·pə·nê nō·ḡə·śāw kî yā·ḏa‘·tî ’eṯ- maḵ·’ō·ḇāw
verses.literal: The LORD said I have indeed seen . . . the affliction of My people in Egypt I have heard them crying out because of their oppressors and I am aware of their sufferings
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Jeová: Certamente, tenho visto a aflição do meu povo que está no Egito e tenho ouvido o seu clamor por causa dos seus superintendentes. Conheço os seus sofrimentos

verses.original: וָאֵרֵ֞ד לְהַצִּיל֣וֹ׀ מִיַּ֣ד מִצְרַ֗יִם וּֽלְהַעֲלֹתוֹ֮ מִן־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִוא֒ אֶל־ אֶ֤רֶץ טוֹבָה֙ וּרְחָבָ֔ה אֶל־ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָ֑שׁ אֶל־ מְק֤וֹם הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַ֣חִתִּ֔י וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·rêḏ lə·haṣ·ṣî·lōw mî·yaḏ miṣ·ra·yim ū·lə·ha·‘ă·lō·ṯōw min- hā·’ā·reṣ ha·hi·w ’el- ’e·reṣ ṭō·w·ḇāh ū·rə·ḥā·ḇāh ’el- ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš ’el- mə·qō·wm hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî wə·ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî
verses.literal: I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land to a good and spacious . . . land a land flowing with milk and honey . . . the home of the Canaanites Hittites Amorites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites
verses.literalPt: e desci para o livrar da mão dos egípcios e para o fazer subir daquela terra para uma terra boa e espaçosa, para uma terra que mana leite e mel; para o lugar do cananeu, do heteu, do amorreu, do perizeu, do heveu e do jebuseu.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִנֵּ֛ה צַעֲקַ֥ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣אָה אֵלָ֑י וְגַם־ רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־ הַלַּ֔חַץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִצְרַ֖יִם לֹחֲצִ֥ים אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nêh ṣa·‘ă·qaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bā·’āh ’ê·lāy wə·ḡam- rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- hal·la·ḥaṣ ’ă·šer miṣ·ra·yim lō·ḥă·ṣîm ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: And now . . . the cry of the Israelites has reached Me and I have seen how severely the Egyptians are oppressing them
verses.literalPt: Agora, eis que o clamor dos filhos de Israel é vindo a mim; demais tenho visto a opressão com que os egípcios os oprimem.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה לְכָ֔ה וְאֶֽשְׁלָחֲךָ֖ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְהוֹצֵ֛א אֶת־ עַמִּ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh lə·ḵāh wə·’eš·lā·ḥă·ḵā ’el- par·‘ōh wə·hō·w·ṣê ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Therefore go I am sending you to Pharaoh to bring My people the Israelites . . . out of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Vem tu, pois, e eu te enviarei a Faraó, para que tires do Egito o meu povo, os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים מִ֣י אָנֹ֔כִי כִּ֥י אֵלֵ֖ךְ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְכִ֥י אוֹצִ֛יא אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm mî ’ā·nō·ḵî kî ’ê·lêḵ ’el- par·‘ōh wə·ḵî ’ō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: But Moses asked God Who am I that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites . . . out of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Perguntou Moisés a Deus: Quem sou eu, para ir a Faraó e para tirar do Egito os filhos de Israel?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כִּֽי־ אֶֽהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ וְזֶה־ לְּךָ֣ הָא֔וֹת כִּ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י שְׁלַחְתִּ֑יךָ בְּהוֹצִֽיאֲךָ֤ אֶת־ הָעָם֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם תַּֽעַבְדוּן֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים עַ֖ל הָהָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer kî- ’eh·yeh ‘im·māḵ wə·zeh- lə·ḵā hā·’ō·wṯ kî ’ā·nō·ḵî šə·laḥ·tî·ḵā bə·hō·w·ṣî·’ă·ḵā ’eṯ- hā·‘ām mim·miṣ·ra·yim ta·‘aḇ·ḏūn ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al hā·hār haz·zeh
verses.literal: I will surely be with you God said and this will be the sign to you that I have sent you When you have brought the people out of Egypt all of you will worship God on this mountain
verses.literalPt: Deus respondeu-lhe: Certamente, eu serei contigo; isto te será por sinal de que eu te enviei: depois de haveres tirado do Egito o povo, servireis a Deus neste monte.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֗ים הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֣י בָא֮ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְאָמַרְתִּ֣י לָהֶ֔ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם שְׁלָחַ֣נִי אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְאָֽמְרוּ־ לִ֣י מַה־ שְּׁמ֔וֹ מָ֥ה אֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî ḇā ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tî lā·hem ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·’ā·mə·rū- lî mah- šə·mōw māh ’ō·mar ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Then Moses asked God Suppose I go to the Israelites . . . and say to them The God of your fathers has sent me to you and they ask me What is His name What should I tell them
verses.literalPt: Disse Moisés a Deus: Eis que, quando eu vier aos filhos de Israel e lhes disser: O Deus de vossos pais enviou-me a vós, e eles me perguntarem: Qual é o seu nome? Que lhes hei eu de responder?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽהְיֶ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶֽהְיֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כֹּ֤ה תֹאמַר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶֽהְיֶ֖ה שְׁלָחַ֥נִי אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- mō·šeh ’eh·yeh ’ă·šer ’eh·yeh way·yō·mer kōh ṯō·mar liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eh·yeh šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: God said to Moses I AM WHO I AM This is what . . . you are to say to the Israelites . . . I AM has sent me to you
verses.literalPt: Disse Deus a Moisés: EU SOU O QUE SOU; e acrescentou: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: EU SOU enviou-me a vós.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ע֨וֹד אֱלֹהִ֜ים אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה כֹּֽה־ תֹאמַר֮ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם אֱלֹהֵ֨י אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִצְחָ֛ק וֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׁלָחַ֣נִי אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם זֶה־ שְּׁמִ֣י לְעֹלָ֔ם וְזֶ֥ה זִכְרִ֖י לְדֹ֥ר דֹּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ‘ō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- mō·šeh kōh- ṯō·mar ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ĕ·lō·hê yiṣ·ḥāq wê·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ šə·lā·ḥa·nî ’ă·lê·ḵem zeh- šə·mî lə·‘ō·lām wə·zeh ziḵ·rî lə·ḏōr dōr
verses.literal: God also told . . . Moses Say to the Israelites . . . The LORD the God of your fathers the God of Abraham the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob has sent me to you This is My name forever and this is how I am to be remembered in every generation . . .
verses.literalPt: Mais disse Deus ainda a Moisés: Assim dirás aos filhos de Israel: Jeová, o Deus de vossos pais, o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque e o Deus de Jacó, enviou-me a vós. É este o meu nome para sempre, e é este o meu memorial para todas as gerações.

verses.original: לֵ֣ךְ וְאָֽסַפְתָּ֞ אֶת־ זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֲלֵהֶם֙ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ נִרְאָ֣ה אֵלַ֔י אֱלֹהֵ֧י אַבְרָהָ֛ם יִצְחָ֥ק וְיַעֲקֹ֖ב לֵאמֹ֑ר פָּקֹ֤ד פָּקַ֙דְתִּי֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ הֶעָשׂ֥וּי לָכֶ֖ם בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: lêḵ wə·’ā·sap̄·tā ’eṯ- ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem nir·’āh ’ê·lay ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām yiṣ·ḥāq wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ lê·mōr pā·qōḏ pā·qaḏ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem wə·’eṯ- he·‘ā·śui lā·ḵem bə·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Go assemble the elders of Israel and say to them The LORD the God of your fathers the God of Abraham Isaac and Jacob has appeared to me and said I have surely attended to . . . you and have seen what has been done to you in Egypt
verses.literalPt: Vai-te, e ajunta os anciãos de Israel, e dize-lhes: Jeová, o Deus de vossos pais, o Deus de Abraão, o Deus de Isaque e o Deus de Jacó, apareceu a mim, dizendo: Certamente, vos tenho visitado e visto o que vos se tem feito no Egito;

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶתְכֶם֮ מֵעֳנִ֣י מִצְרַיִם֒ אֶל־ אֶ֤רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַ֣חִתִּ֔י וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִ֑י אֶל־ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’a·‘ă·leh ’eṯ·ḵem mê·‘o·nî miṣ·ra·yim ’el- ’e·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî wə·ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî ’el- ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš
verses.literal: And I have promised to bring you up out of your affliction in Egypt into the land of the Canaanites Hittites Amorites Perizzites Hivites and Jebusites . . . a land flowing with milk and honey
verses.literalPt: e tenho dito: Eu vos farei sair da aflição do Egito para a terra do cananeu, do heteu, do amorreu, do perizeu, do heveu e do jebuseu, para uma terra que mana leite e mel.

verses.original: וְשָׁמְע֖וּ לְקֹלֶ֑ךָ וּבָאתָ֡ אַתָּה֩ וְזִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֗יִם וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָֽעִבְרִיִּים֙ נִקְרָ֣ה עָלֵ֔ינוּ וְעַתָּ֗ה נֵֽלֲכָה־ נָּ֞א דֶּ֣רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר וְנִזְבְּחָ֖ה לַֽיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mə·‘ū lə·qō·le·ḵā ū·ḇā·ṯā ’at·tāh wə·ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim wa·’ă·mar·tem ’ê·lāw Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·‘iḇ·rî·yîm niq·rāh ‘ā·lê·nū wə·‘at·tāh nê·lă·ḵāh- nā de·reḵ šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm bam·miḏ·bār wə·niz·bə·ḥāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: The elders of Israel will listen to what you say and you must go with them . . . to the king of Egypt and tell him The LORD the God of the Hebrews has met with us Now please let us take a three-day . . . journey into the wilderness so that we may sacrifice to the LORD our God
verses.literalPt: E ouvirão a tua voz, e ireis, tu e os anciãos de Israel, ao rei do Egito e dir-lhe-eis: Jeová, o Deus dos hebreus, encontrou-nos. Agora, pois, deixa-nos ir caminho de três dias ao deserto, para que ofereçamos sacrifícios a Jeová, nosso Deus.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֠י לֹֽא־ יִתֵּ֥ן אֶתְכֶ֛ם מֶ֥לֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם לַהֲלֹ֑ךְ וְלֹ֖א בְּיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî kî lō- yit·tên ’eṯ·ḵem me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim la·hă·lōḵ wə·lō bə·yāḏ ḥă·zā·qāh
verses.literal: But I know that the king of Egypt will not allow you to go unless a mighty hand compels him . . .
verses.literalPt: Eu sei, porém, que o rei do Egito não vos deixará ir, nem mesmo por meio duma mão forte.

verses.original: וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֤י אֶת־ יָדִי֙ וְהִכֵּיתִ֣י אֶת־ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּכֹל֙ נִפְלְאֹתַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְאַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֖ן יְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·laḥ·tî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî wə·hik·kê·ṯî ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim bə·ḵōl nip̄·lə·’ō·ṯay ’ă·šer ’e·‘ĕ·śeh bə·qir·bōw wə·’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên yə·šal·laḥ ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: So I will stretch out My hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders I will perform among them And after that he will release you
verses.literalPt: Portanto, estenderei a minha mão e ferirei o Egito com todas as minhas maravilhas que farei no meio dele; depois, vos deixará ir.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֛י אֶת־ חֵ֥ן הָֽעָם־ הַזֶּ֖ה בְּעֵינֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהָיָה֙ כִּ֣י תֵֽלֵכ֔וּן לֹ֥א תֵלְכ֖וּ רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- ḥên hā·‘ām- haz·zeh bə·‘ê·nê miṣ·rā·yim wə·hā·yāh kî ṯê·lê·ḵūn lō ṯê·lə·ḵū rê·qām
verses.literal: And I will grant this people such favor in the sight of the Egyptians . . . that when you leave you will not go away empty-handed
verses.literalPt: Eu darei graça a este povo aos olhos dos egípcios; e, quando sairdes, não saireis vazios.

verses.original: וְשָׁאֲלָ֨ה אִשָּׁ֤ה מִשְּׁכֶנְתָּהּ֙ וּמִגָּרַ֣ת בֵּיתָ֔הּ כְּלֵי־ כֶ֛סֶף וּכְלֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּשְׂמָלֹ֑ת וְשַׂמְתֶּ֗ם עַל־ בְּנֵיכֶם֙ וְעַל־ בְּנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְנִצַּלְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·’ă·lāh ’iš·šāh miš·šə·ḵen·tāh ū·mig·gā·raṯ bê·ṯāh kə·lê- ḵe·sep̄ ū·ḵə·lê zā·hāḇ ū·śə·mā·lōṯ wə·śam·tem ‘al- bə·nê·ḵem wə·‘al- bə·nō·ṯê·ḵem wə·niṣ·ṣal·tem ’eṯ- miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Every woman shall ask her neighbor and any woman staying in her house for silver . . . and gold jewelry and clothing and you will put them on your sons . . . and daughters So you will plunder the Egyptians
verses.literalPt: Mas cada mulher pedirá à sua vizinha e à sua hóspeda joias de prata, joias de ouro e vestidos; pô-los-eis sobre vossos filhos e sobre vossas filhas e despojareis aos egípcios.
